set.body: Make the currently modeled functional, filter, and hybrid edge classes executable through registry plugins and explicit stage semantics. Distinguish coordinate pullbacks, value transforms, and true fusion barriers so value operations may stage without causing repeated spatial interpolation. Acceptance: registry dispatch is exhaustive for supported plugins and returns typed unsupported errors otherwise; reference functional, filter, and hybrid paths are executable; stage ordering and cache identity are inspectable; tests prove that spatial resampling remains single-pass wherever the mathematics permits it.
set.title: Spatial staged compiler plugins for functional, filter, and hybrid morphisms
